purpose: functional verification of environments on KVM; no timing claim

cases.name: an environment is made and described without its values
a sandbox made with it has its variables and files, and its own envVars win
a sandbox made without it has none of it
after a reboot it still has them, and a fork has them too
a change applies to sandboxes made after it, not one already running
what cannot be is refused, and a deleted environment starts nothing

detail.a path that is not absolute: "rel": a file's path is absolute and names the file
detail.a path that climbs: "/a/../etc/shadow": a file's path has no `..` in it
detail.a name that is not one: an environment's name is 1 to 64 letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.', not starting with '.'
detail.a field that is not one: Failed to deserialize the JSON body into the target type: secrets: unknown field `secrets`, expected `envVars` or `files` at line 1 column 10
